### Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Biotech]** **[PI3Kα/RAS interaction breakers enter clinical evaluation](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2123423835529806162)** — *Jacob Plieth / X*
  * Three PI3Kα/RAS interaction breakers have advanced into clinical trials: BBO-10203 (BridgeBio), BAY 3605349/VVD-159642 (Bayer/Vividion), and FMC-242 (Frontier Medicines).

* **[Mucosal CAR-T cell expansion linked to enterocolitis in BCMA CAR-T therapies](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04731-w)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Profiling of patients with biopsy-confirmed immune effector cell-associated enterocolitis following ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) revealed CAR-T cell infiltrates concentrated in the duodenum, displaying a cytotoxic, highly clonal phenotype with depletion of resident T cells.
  * A concurrent multicenter case series reported that only 32% of patients with BCMA CAR-T-associated enterocolitis achieved resolution at last follow-up, with direct mortality recorded from gastrointestinal complications ([Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04783-y)).

* **[Plasma Alzheimer's biomarkers show cross-sectional agreement but high longitudinal variance](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.16.26368193)** — *bioRxiv / medRxiv*
  * Evaluation of 393 ADNI participants across three plasma samples over 5.0 years demonstrated high cross-sectional agreement across assays (intraclass correlation coefficient 0.75–0.95 for pTau217, pTau181, GFAP, and NfL) but substantially lower agreement on individual longitudinal rates of change (ICC 0.44 for pTau217).
  * Single-assay slope reliability across three sampling timepoints was ≤ 0.52 for all biomarkers and 0.10 for Aβ42/40, indicating high random intrasubject variation in serial monitoring.

* **[Genetically proxied NLRP3 inhibition predicts cardiovascular benefits](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.16.26368176)** — *bioRxiv / medRxiv*
  * Mendelian Randomization using a cis-genetic instrument for NLRP3 downregulation (via C-reactive protein-associated variants in 575,531 participants) demonstrated concordance with downstream biomarker changes and pharmacodynamic responses to the NLRP3 inhibitor ruvonoflast.

* **[Split intein architecture enables ultralarge dual-phage display](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43053366/)** — *PubMed*
  * A selection method utilizing split inteins facilitates ultralarge dual-phage display platforms, expanding molecular diversity screening for peptide and biotherapeutic drug discovery.

---

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[SystImmune initiates US Phase 1 trial for PD-1 × VEGF bispecific SI-B037](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2123394714527572251)** — *Jacob Plieth / X*
  * SystImmune initiated a US Phase 1 clinical trial evaluating SI-B037, entering the competitive clinical space of bispecific antibodies targeting both PD-1 and VEGF pathways.

* **[Dual-targeting BCMA/CD19 CAR-T evaluated in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43053183/)** — *PubMed*
  * A Phase 1/2 study evaluated dual-targeting BCMA/CD19 CAR-T cells constructed with asymmetric 4-1BB/CD28-YMFM costimulation in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.
  * Investigators performed single-cell profiling on extramedullary disease lesions to analyze regional microenvironment responses and resistance patterns.

* **[Revertant autograft replacement evaluated in recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMc2517823)** — *NEJM*
  * Clinical evaluation examined skin graft autotransplantation utilizing expanded naturally occurring somatic revertant mosaic tissue in patients with recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB).

---

### Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Ribociclib combination improves quality of life in aggressive HR⁺/HER2⁻ advanced breast cancer](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43052579/)** — *PubMed*
  * Secondary outcome analysis from the Phase 3 RIGHT Choice trial demonstrated superior health-related quality of life for first-line ribociclib plus endocrine therapy compared with combination chemotherapy in premenopausal patients with aggressive HR⁺/HER2⁻ advanced breast cancer.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab detailed in cisplatin-eligible bladder cancer](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMc2610895)** — *NEJM*
  * Published clinical correspondence reviewed primary efficacy data and regimen tolerability from pivotal Phase 3 testing of enfortumab vedotin in combination with pembrolizumab for untreated cisplatin-eligible advanced urothelial carcinoma.

* **[Biotech]** **[SELLAS Life Sciences concludes enrollment in Phase 3 AML trial](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2123401961718587859)** — *Jacob Plieth / X*
  * SELLAS Life Sciences completed patient accrual for its open-label Phase 3 trial in acute myeloid leukemia, enrolling 126 or 127 patients over a 5-year study period.

---

### Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves Infilbray (venglustat) for neurological manifestations of Type 3 Gaucher disease](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-treat-neurological-symptoms-type-3-gaucher-disease)** — *FDA*
  * The FDA approved Sanofi's Infilbray (venglustat) oral tablets for adult and pediatric patients (weighing ≥15 kg) with Type 3 Gaucher disease (GD3), making it the first therapy approved to treat the central nervous system manifestations of the condition.
  * Venglustat is a brain-penetrant substrate reduction therapy designed to cross the blood-brain barrier and prevent glycsphingolipid accumulation in the CNS.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca files BLA for Claudin18.2 ADC sonesitatug vedotin](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2123330864637702649)** — *Jacob Plieth / X*
  * AstraZeneca submitted a regulatory filing for sonesitatug vedotin based on results from the Clarity-Gastric01 study, seeking approval in gastric cancer patients with Claudin18.2 expression ≥25%.
  * The application carries a target PDUFA date in Q2 2027 and utilizes a lower positivity threshold compared to approved anti-Claudin18.2 antibody zolbetuximab (Vyloy; ≥75%).

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves Regeneron and Alnylam's RNAi therapeutic Livsayis for myasthenia gravis](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/regeneron-fda-approve-cemdisiran-livsayis-myasthenia-gravis-alnylam/875160/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * The FDA approved Livsayis (cemdisiran), an RNAi therapeutic co-developed with Alnylam, marking Regeneron's first commercialized RNAi drug.
  * Livsayis targets complement C5 to treat generalized myasthenia gravis, entering a market space currently populated by FcRn inhibitors and anti-C5 monoclonal antibodies.

* **[FDA adds NAION warning across GLP-1 receptor agonist labels](https://sciencebasedmedicine.org/fda-adds-optic-neuropathy-warning-to-glp-1-ra-drug-labels/)** — *Science-Based Medicine*
  * The FDA required class-wide labeling revisions for all Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) to include warnings regarding the potential risk of nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION).

* **[FDA updates novel approvals, guidance, and enforcement actions](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/novel-drug-approvals-fda/novel-drug-approvals-2026)** — *FDA*
  * **Novel Approvals**: Recent novel CDER drug approvals include Lembaz (adrabetadex) for Niemann-Pick disease type C, Nelkarmi (neladalkib) for ALK⁺ NSCLC, and Wilserdly (giredestrant) for ER⁺/HER2⁻ ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer ([FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/novel-drug-approvals-fda/novel-drug-approvals-2026)).
  * **Solid Tumor Guidance**: The FDA issued a draft guidance providing recommendations for early-phase IND protocol designs in solid tumor oncology trials ([FDA](http://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/early-phase-ind-protocol-recommendations-solid-tumors-draft-guidance-industry)).
  * **Quality Surveillance**: The agency launched the Enhanced Approach for Sampling and Testing (EAST) initiative to modernize screening and accelerate physical quality surveillance across global supply chains ([FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-introduces-new-approach-drug-quality-sampling-and-testing)).
  * **Promotional Compliance**: CDER’s OPDP issued untitled letters to Janssen Biotech regarding INLEXZO (gemcitabine intravesical system) and Vanda Pharmaceuticals regarding NEREUS (tradipitant) ([FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/warning-letters-and-notice-violation-letters-pharmaceutical-companies/untitled-letters)).

---

### Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Pfizer executes $2.6 billion in vivo CAR-T deal with StaRNA](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/pfizer-starna-in-vivo-cell-therapy-autoimmune-disease-deal/875018/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Pfizer entered into a collaboration and license agreement worth up to $2.6 billion with China-based StaRNA to develop mRNA-based in vivo CAR-T cell therapies for autoimmune conditions.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Merck partners with Isomorphic Labs for AI-driven oncology discovery](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/19/merck-isomorphic-labs-partner-to-develop-oncology-drug-candidates/)** — *STAT News*
  * Merck established a strategic research collaboration with Isomorphic Labs to discover small-molecule oncology candidates utilizing Isomorphic's AI-driven structure prediction and molecular design technology.

* **[Biotech]** **[Anson Funds sued over $166 million short-swing profits in SELLAS deals](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123401741677044096)** — *BioStocks / X*
  * A shareholder lawsuit was filed against Anson Funds seeking the disgorgement of $166 million in alleged illegal short-swing profits generated through transactions involving SELLAS Life Sciences stock.

* **[Analysis highlights dynamics of Western licensing for Chinese ADCs and T-cell engagers](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2123439915396374545)** — *X / @andrewpannu*
  * An analysis of ~180 antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) and T-cell engager deals since 2021 involving US, European, or Japanese buyers reveals that China-origin assets expanded from <10% of deal volume in 2021 to ~50% annually since 2023, with ~75% of current Chinese deals focused on novel ADCs.
  * Chinese Phase 1 assets are more than twice as likely to feature clinical patient data at signing (~40% vs ~20% for Western assets), driven by local hospital-level trials that can initiate clinical dosing 12–18 months earlier without requiring a national IND approval.
  * Median upfront deal values for Phase 1 Chinese ADCs were lower than Western counterparts ($59M vs $100M), though clinically validated assets commanded premiums (e.g., Astellas' $130M upfront agreement for Evopoint's CLDN18.2 ADC).

* **[Study outlines drivers of Western pharma licensing for Chinese obesity pipeline](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2123136707805540717)** — *X / @andrewpannu*
  * An evaluation of 36 China-origin obesity candidates at Phase 2 or beyond—of which 9 have been out-licensed to Western companies—shows the pipeline spans GLP-1 monotherapies, GLP-1/GIP dual agonists, triple agonists, and non-incretin modalities.
  * Out-licensing success was primarily driven by multi-agonist mechanisms (which dominated the first wave of deals), Western pharma's preference for acquiring earlier-stage assets from China, and sourcing from established regional players such as Hengrui and Hansoh.
  * Differences in reported weight-loss efficacy, oral versus injectable formulations, and dosing frequency did not significantly correlate with deal execution.

---

### Public Health & Policy

* **[White House withdraws nomination for FDA Commissioner](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/white-house-withdraw-heidi-overton-fda-commissioner-nomination/874961/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * The White House withdrew its nomination of Heidi Overton for FDA Commissioner, shifting agency leadership confirmation dynamics to Congress ([STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/18/fda-after-heidi-overton-burning-questions-agency-future/)).

* **[NIH to relocate last research chimpanzees to sanctuary](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/18/nih-to-move-last-group-of-research-chimps-to-sanctuary/)** — *STAT News*
  * The NIH announced that the final group of government-owned research chimpanzees residing in biomedical laboratories will be transferred to a sanctuary facility in 2027.

* **[US influenza activity surveillance report released for 2025–26 season](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.16.26367927)** — *bioRxiv / medRxiv*
  * National surveillance metrics confirmed that US influenza activity peaked during the week ending December 27, 2025, driven by a dominant initial wave of influenza A(H3N2) subclade K followed by a smaller B/Victoria wave.

---

**Worth watching:** Clinical toxicity management data for BCMA CAR-T therapies as reports of delayed, treatment-refractory mucosal enterocolitis emerge in post-approval surveillance.

- Biology & Health
    - [Creatine may help more than we thought - New Study](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WftKkLzq-d8) -- Physionic
        - Evaluates clinical research on creatine supplementation with and without diet and exercise interventions in middle-aged and older adults.
        - Highlights creatine's effects on lean body mass, body composition, and cognitive function in aging populations.
        - Reviews dosing strategies and muscular performance outcomes in older adults engaged in strength and resistance training.
        - Details findings showing creatine delays the onset of the neuromuscular fatigue threshold and increases muscle strength in older individuals aged 64 to 86.
    - [AI Makes Local Startups Economically Possible](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Tr_nfR6Zi7Q) -- Health2Tech
        - Features Bret Waters discussing how AI-driven drops in software development costs alter startup economics.
        - Explains how lower engineering expenses enable founders to build vertical SaaS applications for smaller, specialized markets.
        - Identifies new entrepreneurial opportunities in niche sectors previously deemed economically unviable for software development.
- Pure Science
    - [Most people don’t understand randomness.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uXuQF_PPg5U) -- Veritasium
        - Explores pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs) such as Linear Congruential Generators (LCGs) and the Mersenne Twister, demonstrating why deterministic algorithms produce predictable streams exploited in gaming and casino hacks.
        - Explains the development and utility of the Monte Carlo method in mathematical modeling, tracing its history from Solitaire to nuclear fission research.
        - Covers cryptographic entropy sources and hardware random number generation, ranging from physical chaos like Cloudflare's lava lamps to secure CSPRNGs.
        - Discusses true quantum randomness, detailing quantum random number generation experiments, Bell tests, and using quasar radiation to eliminate measurement loopholes.
